stories.title: Prince William and Kate to attend Earthshot Prize event today in Mumbai
stories.summary: Senior members of the British royal family, Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, arrived in Mumbai on a two-day visit on Monday. The couple flagged off their tour with a shot at gully cricket alongside cricketer Sachin Tendulkar and schoolgirls from various foundations at Ballard Estate. They savoured sweet tea served to them in a traditional kulhad and enjoyed a ride on the Mumbai Metro train from Vidhan Bhavan to BKC.

stories.title: Mumbai: Mumbra man dies after eating Aflatoon sweet; FDA probe underway
stories.summary: FDA officials admit that they have a challenge on their hands in getting to the root of case where a 35-year-old died, and several are in critical condition from eating aflatoon, a milk-based sweet, in Mumbra last week. A 35-year-old Mumbra man died of multiple organ failure after allegedly consuming a piece of Aflatoon sweet, while five others who ate from the same batch suffered severe vomiting and diarrhoea .

stories.title: Amid Cong protests, BMC proposes 30-year lease of Charkop school land to pvt trust
stories.summary: 70-sq-m plot occupied by the Charkop Sector 2 municipal school in Kandivali to St Mary’s Educational Trust for 30 years to redevelop the school building. The proposal, which does not involve competitive bidding and has drawn strong opposition from Congress corporators, will be placed before the Improvements Committee on Wednesday.

stories.title: ‘200 associates ready in Mumbai’: Gangster Goldy Dhillon issues fresh death threats to Amitabh Bachchan, son Abhishek
stories.summary: Days after the Delhi Police foiled a suspected attack on actor Amitabh Bachchan with the arrests of two people, gangster Gurpreet Singh alias Goldy Dhillon, an alleged aide of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi , has threatened to kill the veteran actor and his son Abhishek Bachchan , alongside alleged perpetrators of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots.

stories.title: Gulzar, Anupam Kher, Kailash Kher To Headline Mumbai's First-Ever 6-Day Book Festival
stories.summary: Organised by the National Book Trust (NBT), India, in association with the Ministry of Education and the Maharashtra government, the festival is the first such event in the city. It aims to bring together diverse voices from literature, cinema, public affairs, science, sports and culture, giving readers an opportunity to interact with prominent personalities and explore a wide range of ideas.

stories.title: Supriya Sule’s support for delimitation bill draws open censure from Natasha Awhad’s daughter
stories.summary: NCP (SP) youth leader Natasha Awhad, daughter of MLA Jitendra Awhad, has strongly opposed her party supporting the delimitation bill, saying she would “absolutely condemn” such a decision if reports were true. Her remarks put her at odds with MP Supriya Sule, who on Saturday said the NCP (SP) would consider supporting the proposal if Lok Sabha seats were increased by 50% across all states.

stories.title: Nearly 18 years after 26/11 Mumbai attacks, Maharashtra's elite Force One commandos now under ATS control
stories.summary: Maharashtra Brings Force One Under ATS Control; Elite Commando Unit To Function Under Unified Command | Mumbai: The state government on Monday placed the administrative and operational control of the elite Force One commando unit under the Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS), placing the two specialised forces under a unified command structure, in a major restructuring of Maharashtra’s counter-terrorism apparatus.

stories.title: BMC patients to get access to 37 beds at Parel's Global Hospital
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has decided to reserve 37 beds at Global Hospital in Parel for eligible patients nominated by the civic body. A memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the BMC and the hospital is set to be signed in the presence of Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde.

stories.title: Santosham launches its newest outlet in Malad, Mumbai
stories.summary: On a general consensus, few food experiences can be less comforting than a freshly-made dosa, crisp around the edges, served hot with chutney and sambar. Bringing such authentic South Indian fare to the table is the newest outlet of Santosham, a 60-seater, Satvik, temple-style vegetarian restaurant founded by Bhagyalakshmi Gohokar and Chittaranjan Gohokar.

stories.title: Mumbai: 12,000 kg of waste collected over weekend in Versova beach clean up
stories.summary: Mumbai's citizen-led beach clean-up initiative, covering Versova and Dana Pani beaches , has nearly completed 610 weeks, with volunteers continuing their efforts to keep the city’s coastline free of marine debris. Over the weekend, the group collected nearly 12,000 kg of waste from Versova beach, of which around 10-15 per cent was recyclable.

stories.title: How visits by British Princes of Wales shaped Mumbai’s history and architecture
stories.summary: Shedding light on the previous visits of Princes of Wales to the city since the late 19th century, Vinayak Talwar, ambassador of Mumbai, Khaki Tours, in an interview with mid-day, delved into how the historical legacies of each such royal figure are reflected in Mumbai, where several landmarks bear their names.

stories.title: Western Railway to introduce prepaid taxi services at six stations to curb overcharging
stories.summary: The Western Railway (WR) will introduce prepaid taxi services at six major stations to curb overcharging of passengers arriving on long-distance trains and provide them with regulated last-mile connectivity. The proposed system, on the lines of the prepaid taxi facility at Mumbai airport, will initially cover Mumbai Central Terminus, Dadar, Bandra Terminus, Borivali, Virar and Palghar.

stories.title: SMAT: Surya’s explosive 29-ball 82 powers Mumbai to easy win over Gujarat
stories.summary: Gujarat did well to post 197, courtesy of the late onslaught from Ashutosh Sharma (42 off 22) and Vishal Jayswal (38 off 21). T20 World Cup-winning captain Suryakumar Yadav smashed a 29-ball 82, his second straight fifty-plus innings, as Mumbai gunned down 198 inside 16 overs in their Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy fixture against Gujarat here on Monday.

stories.title: Artist Kader Attia explores dreams, memory in his curatorial vision for Kochi-Muziris Biennale 2027
stories.summary: Mumbai, Algerian-French artist and curator Kader Attia has proposed reclaiming human sovereignty over dreams and memory in an age increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, placing their relationship with repair at the centre of the seventh edition of the Kochi-Muziris Biennale.

stories.title: Prince William’s Mumbai visit triggers traffic congestion across South Mumbai
stories.summary: Prince William’s visit to Mumbai on Monday brought traffic movement across several parts of South Mumbai to a crawl, with motorists facing congestion on major arterial roads as the Mumbai Traffic Police diverted vehicles and temporarily stopped traffic to facilitate the movement of the royal entourage.

stories.title: Prince William and Princess Catherine enjoy chai and cricket in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Catherine, began their three-day official visit to Mumbai with chai and cricket on Monday . Their first public appearance of the day was at Ballard Estate in Fort. 20 am, cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar took the couple to a chai stall that had been set up on the otherwise tightly secured perimeter opposite NTC House on Narottam Morarjee Marg.

stories.title: Prince William and Princess Catherine experience Mumbai Metro’s Aqua Line
stories.summary: A regular Mumbai Metro train turned into a royal experience when Prince William and Princess Catherine , the Prince and Princess of Wales, stepped aboard the city’s first underground Metro corridor on Monday. The Royal couple got in at Vidhan Bhavan station and continued journey till the Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) Metro station, preventing any further traffic restrictions.

stories.title: Mumbai designer brings Japan’s Eki stamp culture to the city with The Stamp Project
stories.summary: There are two rules to attending an art workshop. Don’t wear white. And, if you must, don’t get your outfit in a colourful mess. We know we’ve found the artist amidst enthusiasts at a Sunday art meet-up in Borivli, because she has broken both. In a bright white shirt covered in stamps from Japan, Ghatkopar-based designer Rayna A quickly becomes the centre of attention in a sea of visitors, young and old.

stories.title: Aaditya Thackeray questions Bhagwati Hospital privatisation
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aaditya Thackeray has criticised the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's (BMC) proposed public-private partnership (PPP) model for the 490-bed Bhagwati Hospital in Borivali, alleging that the tender conditions have been designed to favour selected trusts. He also questioned the civic body's decision to hand over the hospital's operations to a private entity, raising concerns over the future of its public healthcare system and the interests behind the move.

stories.title: Woman living on footpath in Mumbai's Borivali held with cannabis worth Rs 40,650
stories.summary: A 48-year-old woman living on a footpath in Borivali, Mumbai, was arrested for allegedly possessing cannabis for sale, with the police seizing 813 grams of the contraband worth Rs 40,650 and Rs 3,100 in cash. The accused, identified as Lata Shahaji Kale, was found allegedly carrying the narcotic substance near Satyanagar Road, Korakendra Ground No 4, on Sunday, November 15, following a tip-off, according to the Borivali police.

stories.title: Mumbai: Congress Leader Ashraf Azmi Opposes BMCs 30-Year Lease Of Kandivali School Land For ₹4.09 Crore
stories.summary: The party has demanded immediate withdrawal of the proposal and a detailed debate on the controversial 2024 school lease policy in the BMC General Body, questioning the move to hand over valuable public educational assets without wider consultation and scrutiny by elected representatives. According to the proposal before the Improvement Committee, the St.

stories.title: Mumbai: Bandra police face legal setback as court orders release of accused in AI photo manipulation case
stories.summary: The Bandra police arrested a Delhi-based man for allegedly using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to create objectionable morphed photographs of a Bollywood actress and uploading them on social media. However, the arrest suffered a legal setback after the Bandra Holiday Court declared it illegal and ordered the accused’s release.

stories.title: How three Princes of Wales left their mark on Mumbai’s iconic landmarks
stories.summary: Shedding light on the previous visits of Princes of Wales to the city since the late 19th century, Vinayak Talwar, ambassador of Mumbai, Khaki Tours, in an interview with mid-day, delved into how the historical legacies of each such royal figure are reflected in Mumbai, where several landmarks bear their names.

stories.title: Fly91 starts daily Navi Mumbai-Sindhudurg flights after two-year gap
stories.summary: After a two-year gap, air connectivity to Konkan region resumed on Monday, with Goa-based regional airline Fly91 launching daily flights between Navi Mumbai International Airport and Chipi airport in Sindhudurg. The service will operate seven days a week, with the journey taking approximately an hour and 10 minutes.

stories.title: Builders bypassing BMC for redev permissions, causing massive losses: Raut
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut has accused chief minister Devendra Fadnavis of ignoring concerns raised by the municipal commissioner, who had flagged developers for misusing slum-related provisions to secure premium benefits on largely non-slum plots being redeveloped in Mumbai.

stories.title: 36-hr water shutdown to hit Panvel, CIDCO nodes and 14 villages
stories.summary: Panvel city, CIDCO-administered nodes and 14 surrounding villages will be without water for 36 hours, from 9am on Tuesday till 9pm on Wednesday, as the Maharashtra Jeevan Pradhikaran (MJP) undertakes pipeline repairs and other work under Phase I of the Nhava-Sheva Sub-Regional Water Supply Scheme. The Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) area and Panvel railway station will also be affected.

stories.title: After Vaishali Nagar, Bhopal's Shahjahanabad Faces Water Contamination Complaints, BMC Begins Door-To-Door Checks
stories.summary: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): Complaints of contaminated drinking water have surfaced in Shahjahanabad's Old City area following reports of E. coli bacteria in the water supply in Vaishali Nagar. Residents of Sharma Colony along Kumharpura Road alleged that muddy and foul-smelling water had been supplied for the past three days, raising concerns over the quality of drinking water.

stories.title: Could Prince William visit the Mumbai museum that once bore his title?
stories.summary: The museum is now known as the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS) , but was originally called the Prince of Wales Museum. stories.title: Bhopal BMC's Bulldozer Action Returns As 5 Shops Demolished, Over 50 Establishments Face Sealing Notices
stories.summary: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): The Bhopal Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Monday resumed its sealing and demolition drive against illegal commercial establishments operating in residential areas, in compliance with Supreme Court directions. Over 50 establishments across the city were served 24-hour ultimatum notices, while five encroaching shops were demolished in Khajuri Kalan under Huzur tehsil.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai airport takes off on Konkan route with daily Sindhudurg flights
stories.summary: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) has commenced daily flight services to Sindhudurg, strengthening air connectivity between the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and Maharashtra's Konkan region. The services, operated by regional airline FLY91, connect Navi Mumbai with Chipi Airport in Sindhudurg and began on Monday. The daily flights will provide passengers with a direct air link between the two destinations, offering an alternative to longer surface journeys.

stories.title: Aaditya Thackeray gives MU 10-day ultimatum over notice to Yuva Sena member
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader and MLA Aaditya Thackeray, along with party legislators, visited the University of Mumbai on Monday and questioned the administration over a show-cause notice issued to Yuva Sena Senate member Pradeep Sawant. The delegation included MLAs Anil Parab, Ajay Chaudhary, Sunil Prabhu, Varun Sardesai, JM Abhyankar, Sunil Shinde, Manoj Jamsutkar, Anant (Bala) Nar and Mahesh Sawant.

stories.title: 6 Killed, 20 Injured After Bus Plunges 300 Feet Into Gorge In Uttarakhand
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and 26 others injured after a passenger bus veered off the road and plunged into a 100-metre-deep gorge near Gular in Uttarakhand ’s Tehri district early on Tuesday morning. According to officials, the accident occurred around 4:30 am near Gular market when the bus (registration number UK09PA-9779), en route from Haridwar to Chamoli, lost control and fell off the Gular bridge into a ravine below.

stories.title: Odisha Deploys 74 Rescue Teams, Starts Evacuation As Cyclone Akvan Set To Hit Andhra
stories.summary: Manorama Mohanty, director of the Bhubaneswar Meteorological Centre, said Odisha was expected to face a relatively lower impact from Cyclone Akvan compared to Cyclone Arnab. Cyclone Akvan highlights: The deep depression intensified into cyclonic storm Akvan over the central parts of the south and adjoining westcentral Bay of Bengal on Monday evening, IMD stated.

stories.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
stories.summary: A forensic expert has said he believes that convicted sex offender Jeffery Epstein's death in prison was the result of a homicide, not suicide. Speaking to BBC Newsnight, Professor Michael Freeman said that after reviewing the New York City medical examiner's file he believes Epstein was strangled, most likely from behind.

stories.title: Days After Kaziranga Crash, Assam Announces 12-Point Road Safety Plan
stories.summary: Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Monday announced a 12-point action plan to strengthen road safety in view of the road accident in Kaziranga that killed 26 people. The measures include making speed-limiting devices mandatory in commercial vehicles, intensifying checks against speeding and drunk driving, and cancelling permits of vehicles with repeated traffic violations.

stories.title: Jimmy flags ‘back-door takeover’ of Tata Sons by Trusts, supports Chandra & listing
stories.summary: Jimmy, 86, told TOI that he had recently spoken by telephone with Vijay Singh, a trustee of Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT). It was this conversation that was recorded and later documented in a two-page note bearing the signatures of both. The note argues that the induction of members of the Noel Tata family into the trusts was securing "a degree of control over Tata Sons that was never the settlers' intention.

stories.title: Udaipur Man Who Asked Thai-French YouTuber JustKeth For 'Lip Kiss' During Livestream Issues Apology, Says He Is 'Deeply Ashamed'
stories.summary: Days after a video showing him allegedly harassing Thai-French YouTuber and IRL streamer JustKeth during a nighttime livestream in Udaipur went viral, the man has come forward with an apology.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu Minister Aadhav Arjuna’s wife Daisy Martin announces split after 14 years
stories.summary: Daisy Martin, wife of Tamil Nadu Minister Aadhav Arjuna, has officially announced that the couple has mutually decided to end their 14-year marriage. Sharing the news on an Instagram post, Daisy Martin said, "After being a part of each other's lives for 14 years, it's been a journey filled with love, understanding and change, moving through the different chapters of life together as friends, life partners and parents.

stories.title: Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentences of two convicts in the case of the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of seven of her family members during the 2002 riots in Gujarat and granted them bail. B. Varale noted that Bipin Chandra Joshi and Pradeep Mordhiya had been incarcerated for more than 17 years.

stories.title: Ties with Asean crucial for India's Act East Policy: PM
stories.summary: Modi attended a dinner hosted by Philippines President Ferdinand Marcos Jr soon after his arrival, and ahead of the main multilateral and bilateral engagements Tuesday. Trump is expected to spend only a few hours in Manila, before taking off for Shenzhen in China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting.

stories.title: BJP’s Amarinder Singh attends Sonia Gandhi’s book launch event amid show of INDIA bloc unity
stories.summary: As leaders of the INDIA bloc leaders attended the book launch event of senior Congress leader Sonia Gandhi's memoir ‘Belonging: A Journey of Love’ in Delhi on Monday, former Punjab chief minister Captain Amarinder Singh, who switched to the Bharatiya Janata Party in 2022, was among the dignitaries seated in the front row.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know
stories.summary: A weather system brewing over the Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm over the coming days, according to the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD). The system has intensified into a Cyclonic Storm on Monday (November 16, 2026) evening, and is moving north-northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh and has been named ‘Akvan’, a name suggested by Iran under the North Indian Ocean naming list.

stories.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Suneha Sharma remanded to police custody till November 21
stories.summary: A Special Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) court in Mumbai on Monday extended the police custody of Suneha Sharma (Suneha Pandit), the sister-in-law of wanted gang leader Anil Pandit, until November 21. Meanwhile, five other accused were remanded to judicial custody after their police custody ended.

stories.title: 'Part of my body': Sachin Tendulkar gifts 25 bats to MCA Museum
stories.summary: On Monday, Tendulkar, in the presence of his entire family, donated 25 of his possessions to the MCA’s Cricket Museum. These included the first bat he received from his elder sister Savita when he was five years old. Explaining what his bats meant to him, Tendulkar said, "It's an extension of my body.

stories.title: 6 killed after vehicle falls into deep gorge on Banswada-Mohankhal road in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag
stories.summary: Six people were killed and others injured after a vehicle fell into a deep gorge on the Banswada-Mohankhal motor road in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district late Monday night. According to the police, the Bolero vehicle was travelling from the Pokhari area towards Ransi when the driver lost control near Bhatwari-Kandara, causing it to plunge into a deep gorge.

stories.title: 5,000 e-autos to hit roads within a year as Uber, Mahindra announce tie-up
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, one of the two Indian finalists at this year’s Earthshot Prize, on Monday announced its partnership with Uber to support the adoption of 5,000 electric three-wheelers over the next 12 months. While Uber will handhold drivers through the transition, the electric autos are expected to operate only on the Uber app.

stories.title: ‘Rang birangi duniya’: Need to reject black-white binary as climate solutions can come from anywhere, says Prince William
stories.summary: Britain’s Prince William on Monday said that India has shown the world bold ambitions and solutions to protect the environment and aid the planet on the path to recovery. Speaking at the Earthshot Prize Impact Assembly at the Jio Convention Centre in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), he said that we should see the future not in terms of false choices between people and the planet, but in all its colours.

stories.title: Head constable shot dead in Punjab's Gurdaspur, sixth police personnel killed in series of attacks
stories.summary: Unidentified assailants shot dead a 42-year-old head constable in Gurdaspur, the sixth police personnel to be killed in a series of attacks in Punjab this year. Head Constable Vinod Kumar's blood-soaked body, in uniform, was found near the bypass area by his family on Sunday night (November 15, 2026).

stories.title: LeT commander’s associate killed in Kulgam encounter; hunt for him continues
stories.summary: Security forces killed an associate of Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) militant commander Mohammed Lateef Bhat in an encounter in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kulgam district on Monday, as a five-day search operation continued for Bhat, who is believed to be behind an attack on a CRPF post last week in which three personnel were injured.

stories.title: Census Phase-II starts in 4 poll-bound states, postponed in Manipur
stories.summary: Self-enumeration for the population enumeration phase of Census 2027 began on Monday in UP, Punjab, Goa and non-snow-bound areas of Uttarakhand. It will run till Nov 30, followed by house-to-house enumeration from Dec 1. The exercise will collect data across 40 fields, including caste. The question is open-ended and reply will be recorded as declared by the respondent.

stories.summary: Independent Maharashtra MLC Satyajit Tambe has criticised NCP(SP) MLA Rohit Pawar for targeting chief minister Devendra Fadnavis over the plane crash that killed former deputy chief minister Ajit Pawar, saying it was wrong to exploit a tragedy for political gains without concrete evidence. Rohit Pawar had accused Fadnavis of shielding the owners of VSR Ventures, the aviation firm that operated the Learjet 45 aircraft involved in the fatal crash near Baramati.

stories.title: US Court Strikes Down Trump Administration Rule Restricting Stay Of Foreign Students, Researchers And Journalists
stories.summary: Washington: A US federal judge on Monday (local time) struck down a Trump administration rule that sought to restrict the duration of stays for foreign students and journalists. The court order ruled that the policy was "arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, and otherwise not in accordance with law".

stories.title: US govt proposes new rules for Green Cards; says American workers are best
stories.summary: The US government is proposing stricter rules for companies sponsoring foreign workers for employment-based Green Cards. The US Department of Labor says the changes will ensure that qualified American workers get the first opportunity to apply for high-skilled, high-paying jobs before companies turn to foreign workers. “American Workers are the best in the world, and they deserve the first and best job opportunities,” Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said while announcing the proposal.

stories.title: Did India Set Terms For Sheikh Hasina's Extradition? Bangladesh's Reply
stories.summary: India has not set any formal conditions for the return of former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina , Bangladesh reportedly said on Monday. However, Bangladesh's foreign affairs minister Shama Obaed Islam said Dhaka would consider any formal conditions that New Delhi might put forward regarding Hasina's return, Bangladeshi newspaper Prothom Alo reported.

stories.title: Teja Sajja gets engaged to Mourya in Hyderabad; Chiranjeevi, Rana Daggubati attend
stories.summary: Telugu actor Teja Sajja, best known for his leading role in ‘Hanu-Man,’ has got engaged to his lady love, Mourya. stories.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 17 dead
stories.summary: South African police are investigating the murders of 17 people in two separate shootings on Sunday night. Eight men were fatally shot in a minibus in KwaZulu-Natal province. Police declared them dead when they arrived at the scene. Hours later, nine people were found shot dead inside a shack in western Pretoria.

stories.title: US deploys third aircraft carrier to Middle East amid escalating tensions with Iran
stories.summary: The deployment comes as diplomatic efforts between Washington and Tehran remain stalled and US President Donald Trump is considering whether to resume large-scale military strikes against Iran. The USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, bringing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three amid continued tensions with Iran, a US official confirmed.

stories.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
stories.summary: Five EU countries have announced a deal to establish a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda as part of a broader push to boost deportations and curb irregular migration. Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to open a "return hub" ready to accept transfers in 2027, the Dutch and Danish governments said.

stories.title: Israeli opposition chiefs denounce Netanyahu over ‘attempted coup’
stories.summary: Two Israeli opposition leaders denounced Monday (November 16, 2026) an "attempted coup" following press reports that outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office tried to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party ahead of last month's election. stories.title: Ukraine hits Russia's Crimea bridge in 1,300-drone barrage
stories.summary: Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at Russia overnight, aiming towards Moscow and hitting a symbolic bridge that links the annexed Crimean peninsula to Russia. The strike on the bridge appeared to inflict only minor damage, though drew an angry response from Russian-installed officials.

stories.title: Estonia to close Russia border crossings after attempted drone factory arson attack
stories.summary: Estonia has said it will close border crossings into Russia from 1 December after accusing Moscow of being behind an attempted arson attack at a drone factory. Prime Minister Kristen Michal said the break-in on Saturday at a facility north of the capital Tallinn was part of what he called Russia's "broader hybrid war against Europe".

stories.summary: Juhu beach saw garbage collection surge fivefold to 150 tons on Monday, a day after Chhath Puja celebrations drew thousands to the shoreline. The figure was 120 tons above the beach's average daily collection of 30 tons over the preceding eight days. An official said cleaning operations could not begin on Sunday evening, despite staff being ready, as the beach was packed with people, leaving no room for workers or machinery.

stories.title: Mumbai: Siddhivinayak Temple Introduces Four New Special Pujas, Fees Go Upto ₹50,000
stories.summary: The newly introduced rituals include Sahasranama Mahaprasad Puja, Sahasranama Ashirvachan Mahapuja, Shringarika Puja and Atharvashirsha Havan. Devotees wishing to perform these pujas or seeking further information can contact the puja booking counter at the temple. The initiative offers devotees an additional opportunity to offer prayers and devotional services at the feet of Lord Ganesha.

stories.title: Dombivli youth drowns during Chhath Puja in Kalyan; body recovered after 13 hours
stories.summary: The deceased, identified as Jugnu Kashyap, a resident of Dombivli, had visited the pond with his family on Sunday evening to perform Chhath Puja rituals. The incident occurred around 6 pm when, according to eyewitnesses, Jugnu entered a deeper section of the pond, apparently unaware of its depth.

stories.title: 'Agar Kunwara Ladka Kar Sakta Hai...': Akshara Singh REACTS To Chhath Puja Controversy, Calls Out Double Standards
stories.summary: Bhojpuri actress Akshara Singh has reacted to criticism over performing Chhath Puja rituals, after several videos showed her standing in water and wearing orange sindoor. Several users questioned her participation in the festival despite being unmarried, while others alleged that the appearance was staged for publicity.

stories.title: Temple for PM Modi’s late mother to come up in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district
stories.summary: A temple dedicated to Heeraben Modi, the late mother of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is being constructed in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district as a tribute to her, a charitable trust overseeing the project said on Monday, describing it as a symbol of a son’s reverence for his mother.

stories.title: Kalpathy witnesses grand meeting of temple chariots
stories.summary: Thousands of people from across the State and Tamil Nadu gathered at Kalpathy on Monday evening to witness the convergence of temple chariots, marking the finale of the annual car festival. 30 pm. The chariots represented the Viswanathaswamy Temple, Kalpathy; Manthakkara Sree Mahaganapathy Temple, New Kalpathy; Sree Lakshminarayana Perumal Temple, Old Kalpathy; and Sree Prasanna Mahaganapathy Temple, Chathapuram.

stories.title: Uttarakhands Madhyamaheshwar Dham Closes For Winter; Know Where Devotees Can Seek Darshan?
stories.summary: Madhyamaheshwar Temple or Madmaheshwar is a Hindu temple which is located in Gaundar. It is a village in Rudraprayag district of Uttarakhand. The temple is a part of the Panch Kedar circuit, including Kedarnath, Tungnath, Rudranath, and Kalpeshwar, which is dedicated to Lord Shiva.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia joins Chhath Puja at Juhu Beach! Her Bihar connection may surprise you
stories.summary: Bollywood actor Tamannaah Bhatia joined hundreds of devotees celebrating Chhath Puja at Mumbai's Juhu Beach on November 15! Dressed in a bright yellow salwar suit, the actor greeted worshippers and participated in the festivities. She later shared a video on Instagram, thanking devotees for their affection and seeking Chhathi Maiya's blessings.

stories.title: Tata Power installs battery storage systems in Mahalaxmi, Saki and Mankhurd
stories.summary: Tata Power has operationalised 60 MWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across three strategic locations in Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi, Saki, and Mankhurd to strengthen the city's electricity distribution network and improve power reliability. Officials noted that the installations are expected to help manage peak electricity demand, optimise power procurement costs and improve the resilience of the city's power supply network, which serves more than eight lakh consumers.

stories.title: AQI ‘poor’ in parts of Kolkata, outskirts amid Chhath celebrations
stories.summary: Air quality in parts of Kolkata and its outskirts remained 'poor' on Monday (November 16, 2026) following the bursting of firecrackers during Chhath Puja celebrations in the early morning hours, a West Bengal Pollution Control Board (WBPCB) official said. Barrackpore on the northern fringes of Kolkata recorded an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 230, placing it in the 'poor' category, according to air monitoring data, the official said.

stories.title: Every Chhath, the same question returns: Why is the Yamuna still polluted?
stories.summary: Every year during Chhath Puja, images of devotees standing amid toxic foam bring the Yamuna’s pollution crisis back into focus. Despite decades of court interventions, government plans and cleanup projects, the river remains heavily polluted as it passes through Delhi. Experts say the key challenge is not just increasing river flow, but stopping untreated sewage and waste from entering the river in the first place.

stories.title: Sabarimala temple to open for annual pilgrimage; AI cameras part of crowd management
stories.summary: The sanctum sanctorum of the Sabarimala temple will open on Monday ahead of the annual Mandalam - Makaravilakku pilgrimage season, which begins on November 17. While the pilgrimage season formally begins Tuesday, which marks the first day of the Malayalam month of Vrischikam, the temple doors will open to pilgrims on Monday evening itself.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia joins Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai, shares video after The Vvaan's festive sequence won hearts
stories.summary: Actor Tamannaah Bhatia recently joined devotees at Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai. The actor took to Instagram to share a video from the celebrations, in which she was seen interacting with fans and taking part in the festivities. Tamannaah recently featured in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, and the film's Chhath Puja sequence received much love from audiences.

stories.title: Chhath Puja In Japan: Bihari Family Performs Rituals In Tokyo, Offers Arghya To Rising Sun; Videos Go Viral
stories.summary: Thousands of miles away from Bihar, a family from the state brought the spirit of Chhath Puja to Tokyo, Japan, observing the four-day festival with traditional rituals and prayers. Videos of the celebration, showing family members offering Arghya to the rising Sun and singing Chhath songs, have gone viral on social media.
